Microfibrillated Cellulose for Coatings

An application area for evaluating cellulose-based rheology, flow and suspension in water-based coating systems.

Define the coating behaviour you need

Flow during application

Compare application viscosity, shear response and recovery with the existing binder system.

Pigment suspension

Measure settling and redispersibility with your pigment loading and storage conditions.

Finished-film properties

Check appearance, adhesion, water response and other relevant film properties. Do not infer them from wet-state rheology.

Development and evaluation status

NeoNaar is exploring MFC for coatings as a development application. A cellulose rheology modifier or bio-based coating additive must be evaluated with the actual binder, dispersants and pigments. This page does not represent a validated coating grade or a performance specification.
